title: Polynomial-time unary encoding of a quadratic width expression
statement: Let $A,a,k,l\in\mathbb N$. The function sending a bit string $y$ to a unary string of length $kV^2+lV$ is polynomial-time computable, where $V=A(|x|+1)^a$ and $x$ is the decoded first component of $y$ (empty if decoding fails).
